bio: Perfectly fried foie gras topped with a very fine brunoise of green apple and dried pink peppercorns; underneath, expertly fried beetroot and mouthwateringly crisp apple. These elements are accompanied by a warm beetroot coulis, apple and curry with a subtle piquancy that elevates all the flavours, along with a delicate oil infused with dill. This dish is typical of De Woage: seemingly simple creations that are generous, without any unnecessary frills and packed with flavour.Jelle Jansen is by no means workshy, as his fine à la carte offerings prove – he pulls out all the stops for his diners. The quality of the produce comes first. Sauces play a leading role, such as the wonderfully sharp/spicy curry sauce that takes the cod fillet served with a mussel and tomato tapenade to the next leve...
